params.headline: You don't need more willpower
params.subheadline: You need a protocol your body can actually follow

params.myth: More cardio is the fastest route to fat loss.
params.fact: Recovery drives adaptation. Sleep and rest are when your body actually changes.
params.explanation: In our cohort, members who prioritized sleep lost 2.3x more body fat than the cardio-only group.

params.definition: The stress hormone that, chronically elevated, blocks fat loss and disrupts sleep.
params.context: Spiking it with dawn cardio while sleep-deprived is the fastest way to stall progress.
params.example: Replace the 5am sprint with a 10-minute walk until your sleep debt clears.

params.definition: Easy-effort cardio (conversation pace) that builds aerobic base without frying recovery.
params.context: 80% of your cardio volume should live here.
params.example: Brisk walk, easy spin, or incline hike at a 3/10 effort.

params.title: The 12-week shift
params.before: Waking exhausted, 2 cups of coffee by 9am, cardio-only training
params.after: Deep sleep nightly, 3 strength sessions, steady energy all day
params.description: Measured change, not a vibe — the numbers moved because the habits did.
